purpose: A Verilog flip-flop clocked through the A2D threshold band: hysteresis rejects a glitch that stays inside the band, and each real edge toggles q once.

oracle.derivation: vth = 2.5 V, vhys = 1 V: clk rises through 3 V at 6 ns and 28 ns; the 14 ns dip to 2.2 V stays above 2 V. q toggles at 6 ns and 28 ns with 1 ns linear ramps to 5*1000/1001 V. Mid-ramp samples allow 5 mV for the ramp start, which lags the crossing by at most ttol = 0.5 ps (2.5 mV). Without the band q would fall at 14.43 ns and read 0 at 16 ns and 24 ns.
